title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and tidy dependency hygiene
author: Maya Chen
description: Consolidate multiple GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and release automation into a smaller set of focused workflows and clean up devDependencies across a few repos. Motivation: reduce CI queue latency, improve cache hit rate, make release automation more robust against transient failures, and reduce maintenance surface for action versions. Changes include splitting long multi-job files into reusable workflows, standardizing node versions and cache keys, moving common steps to composite actions, and pruning unused devDependencies in package.json files that caused frequent audit/lock churn. This PR also adds a CI health check job that proactively warns when cache hit rates drop below threshold and documents the recommended cadence for bumping actions. Checklist: [x] consolidate lint/test workflows into ci-lint.yml and ci-test.yml, [x] unify release automation into workflows/release.yml using the standard release composite, [x] introduce shared workflow templates in .github/workflows/templates, [x] bump critical GH Action pins and add dependabot config for actions, [x] remove obsolete devDependencies from root package.json and redwood-sdk-python package.json, [x] add a short CONTRIBUTING CI section to docs to describe the new flow.

Priya Natarajan: Can we ensure the release workflow has a manual trigger and preserves existing semantic-release envs? Also requested an integration test for canary publishes.
Maya Chen: Reply: release workflow added workflow_dispatch and created a lightweight canary step that runs only on dedicated canary tags. Added notes in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Samir Patel: Noted flaky test in ci-test matrix on node 18 during windows runners, requested retry logic and a follow-up ticket if flakes persist.
Maya Chen: Reply: added exponential backoff retry step around npm install for windows and created ENG-1499 to track windows runner flakes.

dependabot/merge — pending will run after merge
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows for linting and testing, introduced shared composite actions for cache and node setup, pruned unused devDependencies, and stabilized release automation. No user-facing behavior changes. Recommended: monitor CI cache hit rate and bump action pins quarterly.
summary: This PR reduces CI complexity and maintenance overhead while improving cache performance and release reliability. It should lower CI queue times and make future workflow updates easier.
